scope: 108 freshly exported Figma roots: 51 product/brand body roots, 41 decision/journey roots, 16 FX original/vector roots. Separate exact composition audit covers restored home/heroes.
method: Decoded embedded raster RGBA hashes, 96px render nearest-neighbour triage, then paired visual sheets for decisions/journeys, Deal gallery, Winking historical captures, FX originals and identified Fusion framing differences. Nearest-neighbour RMSE is candidate discovery only, not a parity proof.
limitations: Visual comparison is not byte identity and does not validate every text glyph or implementation claim. New exact composition packing parity is separately recorded. AI mobile source clipping repaired by journey agent; complete website screenshot retained.
